name: subagent-routing-kit
description: Subagent delegation policy skill plus a PreToolUse hook that checks spawn_agent model and reasoning effort against a Codex capability snapshot.

interface.shortDescription: Delegation policy and a spawn_agent model/effort guard
interface.longDescription: Bundles a delegation-policy skill and a PreToolUse hook. The hook checks the model and reasoning effort requested for spawn_agent (and any matching custom agent file) against a snapshot of the Codex CLI's bundled model catalog. The hook must be reviewed and trusted in /hooks before it runs.
